scientific_queries.note: Four-predictor comparison under joint cell+drug holdout on GDSC.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round delivers the programme's decisive negative on its own modelling route and rewrites the synthesis accordingly.

design.holdout: 20% of 125 cells and 20% of 65 drugs jointly

final_negative.sharpest_single_contrast: on the unseen-drug pool the marginal baseline fills an unseen drug with 0 ('unknown') and still scores 9.12%, while the annotation model, for which the pathway annotation IS available for that drug, scores 5.12%
final_negative.implication: knowing a drug's pathway is worth less than knowing the average synergy of the drug it is paired with

what_is_NOT_claimed: this does not say synergy is unpredictable - it is clearly predictable (drug marginals 9.12%, two-way additive 15.88%); it says the pathway-annotation modelling route adds nothing at the decision level
limits: the pathway annotation is coarse (38 pathway levels), so the finding may be about this granularity rather than about pathways in general
drug marginals require each drug to appear in training; unseen drugs fall back to zero
tissue is still mostly seen even under the joint holdout
single dataset; retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: either obtain a finer annotation (not available locally) or accept that this modelling route does not work
